correctness.rationale: A zero multiplier followed by a zero multiplier makes the state exactly (0,0) forever; the first waiting pair occurs a.s. and first-step conditioning gives mean waiting time (1+r)/r^2. For integer k>=1 the binomial expansion closes k+1 nonnegative mixed moments into B_k(M,w), with strong-connectedness and an aperiodic loop giving primitivity for M,w>0; Perron–Frobenius gives an asymptotic positive multiple of rho(B_k)^t. The Perron root is strictly increasing in M, vanishes at M=0 and is <1 at M=1 by geometric absorption, so unique M_k>1. Determinants yield M1=1/w and M2=(sqrt(1+8/w)-1)/2. Lyapunov moment comparison gives M_{k+1}<=M_k; an all-retained run has growth root R_M>1 for each M>1 and forces M_k->1. Fresh independent numeric threshold checks at w=1/2 and orders 1..6 give approx 2,1.56155,1.38513,1.28735,1.22701,1.18691; finite checks not infinite proof.
